definition: An agent, in this sense, is a loop in which a model chooses actions, observes their results, and continues until a goal is met or a limit is reached. Tool calling is the usual way it acts. The loop needs a budget, because nothing inside the model guarantees that it will stop.
prompt: What is an agent built on a language model?
examples: A loop that searches, reads a result, and searches again
A coding assistant that edits a file and then runs a test
